rule: No original feature may be deleted or simplified without a row in this matrix. schema=present is not behavior=ported.

features.note: article.afterPostHtml is rendered after the post. The preview post includes 文末补充.
Archives pass article.timelineShowMonth into the timeline renderer. The preview still shows month nodes because the option defaults to on.
Year links use article.archivesUrl and stay on the site. A wp-json base is replaced with /archives/.
The preview homepage includes the configured article header style class.
The home list uses article-list-1, article-list-2, or article-list-3. The preview homepage includes article-list-1.
The client lays out article cards when article.waterflow is not 1. The sample config keeps a single column.
Article cards follow article.meta order. Missing views are omitted instead of showing a fake count. Edit time is not ported.
WordPress runtime path, update checker, or admin-only preview. Not a visitor-facing theme behavior.
The preview banner includes the configured shape-primary color class.
The preview homepage includes shape-style-1 when shapes are not hidden.
banner.backgroundUrl is written as the banner background image. The sample config has no image, so the preview does not show one.
Banner size maps to banner-mini, no-banner, or banner-as-cover. The sample uses the normal size, so the preview has the shaped banner without those extra classes.
The preview homepage includes banner-subtitle from the config.
The preview homepage includes the banner title.
The preview banner title includes data-interval from banner.typingInterval.
The preview homepage includes the card radius style from appearance.cardRadius.
Small card shadow adds use-small-shadow. Big shadow adds use-big-shadow. The preview homepage includes use-small-shadow.
codeBreakLine adds hljs-break-line after highlight.js runs. It was not observed in a browser.
codeHideLineNumber adds hljs-hide-linenumber after highlight.js runs. It was not observed in a browser.
codeTransparentLineNumber adds hljs-transparent-linenumber after highlight.js runs. It was not observed in a browser.
The highlight client loads /argon/vendor/highlight/styles/{codeTheme}.css. The sample theme is vs2015.
Editing posts only to /api/comments with action edit. The plugin checks the author email and keeps the previous text in argon_edit_history. A live WordPress update was not run.
The comment form can show a reply-notice checkbox. The private handler forwards mailNotice, and the plugin stores argon_mail_notice. It does not send mail.
Baked comments can render a small Markdown subset at build time. The live comment editor does not yet offer a Markdown toggle.
Private baked comments keep the badge and omit the text from static HTML. A private viewing channel is not implemented.
comments.avatarVcenter adds comment-avatar-vertical-center. The sample config leaves it off.
A local keyboard inserts the original text emotions and :smile: stickers. Stickers render as comment-sticker from /argon/emotions. The full upstream sticker pack is not copied.
A 5 to 11 digit QQ number becomes a q1.qlogo.cn avatar. The comment list test confirms author email is not returned to the browser.
mailNoticeChecked controls whether that checkbox starts selected. No mail is sent.
The private comment handler can require an HMAC captcha token. The browser challenge form is not wired yet, and the sample build does not enable it.
Comment lists can be sliced into pages. The live WordPress endpoint still returns the full approved list; page mode is applied in the client.
Baked comments can show a parsed platform and browser in comment-useragent. The original icon font mapping is not fully ported.
WordPress runtime path, update checker, or admin-only preview. Not a visitor-facing theme behavior.
footer.html is rendered in the site footer. The preview homepage includes 本地页脚.
appearance.customHeadHtml is inserted in the document head. The preview includes the generator meta tag.
When appearance.darkmode is system and the visitor has not chosen, the page follows prefers-color-scheme. A stored choice wins.
Post dates follow site.dateFormat. The preview homepage shows the YMD form. MDY and DMY are implemented but not shown in the current config.
disableCodeblockStyle adds disable-codeblock-style on the html element. The sample config leaves the Argon code style on.
Google fonts are omitted when disableGoogleFont is true. The preview homepage does not load fonts.googleapis.com.
The content area gets argon-enter only when pjax animation is enabled. The preview homepage includes that class.
The post page shows article.donateQr. The preview post includes /argon/donate.svg and does not call WordPress.
amoledDark adds amoled-dark on the html element. The sample config leaves it off.
The banner title uses the typing markup when banner.typing is on. The typing motion was not observed in a browser.
Code highlight loads the local highlight.js bundle only when motion.codeHighlight is true. It does not use a CDN.
Pinned baked comments show the original badge class. Pinning through the private API is not implemented.
Comment upvote posts only to /api/comment-upvote. The handler test does not echo the CMS host.
Article images open a same-page lightbox and use fancybox-wrapper. This is not the upstream Fancybox plugin.
Headroom toggles the original pinned and unpinned classes when toolbar.headroom is true. It was not observed in a browser.
immersionColor adds immersion-color. The sample config leaves it off.
intoArticleAnimation adds post-preview on article cards.
Images with data-original load through IntersectionObserver when motion.lazyload is on. It was not observed in a browser.
WordPress runtime path, update checker, or admin-only preview. Not a visitor-facing theme behavior.
The viewport meta allows user scaling when mobileScale is on. The preview includes width=device-width.
CJK/Latin spacing runs at build time when motion.pangu includes article.
Local search can filter posts, pages, and shuoshuo without calling WordPress. The filter function is unit-tested.
smoothScroll adds argon-smooth-scroll unless it is disabled. The other original scripts are not ported.
WordPress runtime path, update checker, or admin-only preview. Not a visitor-facing theme behavior.
Zoomify toggles a scale transform from zoomifyScale. It was not observed in a browser.
The dark-mode FAB button is rendered when fab.darkmode is on and the client toggles the theme class. Not checked in a browser this round.
The comment FAB button scrolls to #comments when fab.comment is on. Not checked in a browser this round.
The settings FAB opens the local appearance popup. Not checked in a browser this round.
When a post has no cover, the card can use the first content image. CMS API image URLs are rejected.
Client folds a comment when its rendered height is over 800px, matching the original rule, and adds an expand button. It was not observed in a browser.
Home shuoshuo cards receive the foldable class when foldLongShuoshuo is on. The preview homepage includes shuoshuo cards.
appearance.font serif adds use-serif. The sample uses sans.
The preview homepage renders footer.html.
The form asks the same-origin /api/comments?captcha=1 endpoint. The test confirms that request does not call the CMS.
Comment avatars can use a Gravatar hash and a configurable HTTPS CDN. wp-json hosts are rejected, and the email is not rendered.
hideCategories removes categories from article card meta. The sample config leaves categories visible.
The preview footer still shows the Astro port credit because hideAuthor is off.
hideAuthorInputs removes the name, email, and site fields from the WordPress comment form. Logged-in WordPress user identity is not available in the static page.
When hideShortcodeInPreview is on, card summaries strip [shortcode] text. The sample config leaves the stripper off.
The preview homepage includes shuoshuo cards because home.showShuoshuo is on.
KaTeX is loaded from /argon/vendor/katex, not from a CDN. A CDN URL is not used for KaTeX.
lazyloadEffect fadeIn adds lazyload-fade. Other effect names stay on the plain lazyload class.
The fade effect is the only loading style implemented. The original numbered loading icons are not ported.
Lazyload root margin uses motion.lazyloadThreshold. Values outside 0 to 5000 fall back to 800.
KaTeX renders inline and display math at build time from local files. MathJax modes are not implemented.
MathJax is included only when math mode is mathjax and the URL is explicit HTTPS. CMS URLs are rejected. The sample stays on local KaTeX.
MathJax 2 uses the same safe URL gate and is not loaded in the sample.
Posts older than outdatedDays show the configured tip. Zero disables it. The sample config is zero, so the preview does not show the tip.
Absolute mode appends the formatted date. Relative mode omits it. The sample uses absolute.
The outdated notice uses article.outdatedTip. It is not shown while outdatedDays is 0.
Outdated notices can be warning or info. The sample uses warning and outdatedDays is 0, so the preview post does not show it.
Page background CSS can use a separate dark image and a transparent banner. The current sample config has no background image, so the preview does not show one.
A separate dark background image is used when background.darkUrl is set.
Background opacity is clamped between 0 and 1.
pageBackgroundCss uses background.url. The sample has no background image.
The preview homepage includes double-column for the default layout. single, triple, and reverse layouts add their own classes.
ClientRouter is included only when motion.pjax is true. The sample keeps it on.
Reading time uses article.readingSpeed, readingSpeedEn, and readingSpeedCode. Code blocks count non-empty lines. The preview post still shows the reading label and no wp-json.
Reading time uses article.readingSpeed, readingSpeedEn, and readingSpeedCode. Code blocks count non-empty lines. The preview post still shows the reading label and no wp-json.
Reading time uses article.readingSpeed, readingSpeedEn, and readingSpeedCode. Code blocks count non-empty lines. The preview post still shows the reading label and no wp-json.
Local content and headless snapshots both use applyReferences. A snapshot with a repeated reference produced a and b backlinks and no wp-json. A live WordPress round-trip was not run.
Single posts render a related-posts list from shared tags or categories. The preview post page includes that section.
The related list is sliced to article.relatedLimit.
After the relevance score, related posts sort by relatedOrder. The sample is descending.
relatedOrderBy accepts date or title. The sample uses date.
Search filters follow article.searchFilters. The preview search page includes post, page, and shuoshuo filters.
The preview homepage includes a description meta tag from the site config.
The preview homepage includes the keywords meta tag from site.keywords.
Baked comments can show the parent author. Live WordPress comments do not yet include that field.
The settings popup includes the theme color picker when allowColorPicker is on.
Catalog items can be prefixed with 1, 1.1, 2 when article.showCatalogNumbers is true. The sample config leaves it off, so the preview does not show numbers.
Reading time uses the original speed formula and labels. The sample post shows post-meta-detail-words. Code-line counting is approximate.
Share buttons use the original icon classes and public share URLs. They do not call WordPress.
When thumbnailInBanner is on, a post cover can become the banner background. CMS API image URLs are rejected. The sample post has no cover, so this page does not show that background.
banner.toolbarMask adds toolbar-mask. The preview homepage includes that class.
The sidebar renders sidebar.announcement. The preview homepage includes 本地公告.
The sidebar author image element is rendered and uses sidebar.authorImage when set. The sample has no image.
The preview homepage shows the sidebar author name.
The sidebar shows authorDescription when it is set. The sample config includes a description.
The preview sidebar includes 本地侧栏.
The sidebar banner title falls back to the site title. The preview uses Argon.
Comments without a QQ number can show a Gravatar image from the email hash. The sample baked comments do not include hashes yet.
The preview homepage includes the configured theme color #5e72e4.
WordPress runtime path, update checker, or admin-only preview. Not a visitor-facing theme behavior.
toolbar.blur adds toolbar-blur. The preview homepage includes that class.
The preview homepage includes the toolbar icon image.
The toolbar icon links to toolbar.iconLink, defaulting to the site root. The preview includes /argon/toolbar-icon.svg.
The preview homepage includes the main toolbar.
Card summaries are cut to article.trimWords. The sample uses 120.
WordPress runtime path, update checker, or admin-only preview. Not a visitor-facing theme behavior.
Previous comment text is stored in comment meta. There is no public history viewer yet.
WordPress runtime path, update checker, or admin-only preview. Not a visitor-facing theme behavior.
Zoomify transition duration uses motion.zoomifyDuration, clamped to 0-2000ms.
Zoomify transition easing uses motion.zoomifyEasing when it is a simple CSS timing value.
Zoomify scale uses motion.zoomifyScale. Values outside 0-2 fall back to 0.9.

Client toggles the original headroom---pinned and headroom---unpinned classes. Not compared in a browser yet.
Column placement matches the original width breakpoints and shortest-column rule. The DOM binder is wired, but it was not observed in a browser.
Images with data-original load through IntersectionObserver. Not compared in a browser yet.
Images can toggle the zoomify/zoomed classes and a scale transform from the configured scale. This is not the upstream zoomify library and was not checked in a browser.
Article images get the original zoomify and fancybox-wrapper classes and open a same-page lightbox. This is not the upstream Fancybox plugin and was not checked in a browser.
Local highlight.js and the vs2015 theme are copied into the theme. The client loads only /argon/vendor/highlight when code highlight is enabled. Line-number behavior was not observed in a browser.
KaTeX 0.19.1 is vendored under /argon/vendor/katex. Inline and display math are rendered at build time. MathJax 2/3 modes are still not implemented.

The sidebar catalog links to heading ids and marks the section nearest the scroll position. It was not observed in a browser.
When smooth scroll is not disabled, the built page adds argon-smooth-scroll and uses CSS scroll-behavior. The other three original smooth-scroll scripts are not ported.
Cover, gallery, media-text, and the video shortcode now drop wp-json, wp-admin, and admin-ajax.php URLs even when rewriting does not change them. Not every shortcode or block interaction is covered.
Argon collapse/alert/admonition/github/progressbar have a build-time renderer. Tab and timeline blocks are not covered yet.
The RSS block always links to the local /feed.xml and ignores a WordPress feed URL. The preview Gutenberg page includes wp-block-rss and no wp-json. Not every core interaction is covered.
Unknown blocks keep saved HTML, media URLs are rewritten, and compatibilityReport marks them saved-html-only. That is not a certification.

A password field causes the body and the password itself to be omitted from the static page. Unlocking through WordPress login is intentionally not used. A private unlock API is not implemented yet. Headless snapshot now drops password-protected bodies, passwords, and their media URLs.

zh-CN, zh-TW, en, ru
Local sidebar widgets render from argon.config.yml into leftbar-tools. WordPress widget instances are not imported yet.
GitHub cards use the original class names. Stats can be filled at build time from the GitHub API through an injected fetch, never through admin-ajax. The sample build does not call GitHub.
Local mode increments the count in sessionStorage and does not call WordPress. Headless mode posts only to /api/shuoshuo-upvote. Neither path was observed in a browser.
Comment upvote posts only to /api/comment-upvote. The handler test confirms the CMS host is not returned to the browser. A live WordPress comment meta update was not run.
syncDecision skips local builds, fails closed when WordPress credentials are missing, and syncs only when all three env values are present. A live WordPress round-trip was not run.

Image, file, button, and saved HTML src/href values that still contain wp-json, wp-admin, or admin-ajax.php are removed even when URL rewriting does not change them. A full static rebuild was not run this round.
The comment handler refuses cross-origin calls and does not echo the CMS host. Platform adapters exist; they are not deployed in this run.

pnpm build now runs sync-wordpress before the fail-closed snapshot check. Missing credentials exit 1 and remove the completion marker. The GitHub workflow uses Node 24. It was not fired against a live account.
